_about: Public-domain J. E. C. Welldon, Headmaster of Harrow, Bishop of Calcutta and Dean of Durham, for the Word Hoard: his Harrow sermons (The Spiritual Life, The Fire upon the Altar, Youth and Duty), The Hope of Immortality, The Revelation of the Holy Spirit, The School of Faith, The Gospel in a Great City, lectures on disestablishment, Recollections and Reflections, and shorter essays. His Aristotle translations are left to the Aristotle shelf. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 121 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.
